definitions.explanation: Ridiculous statements that make no sense, as if spoken while dreaming. Often used dismissively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{寝言|ねごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I often talked in my sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寝言|ねごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧つぶやいて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He was muttering something in his sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧、⟦{妻|つま}→妻：01005_tsuma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{寝言|ねごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさかった→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Last night, my wife told me my sleep-talking was loud.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{疲|つか}れていた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、{寝言|ねごと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Maybe because she was tired, she was talking about work in her sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{寝言|ねごと}、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{信|しん}じない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Nobody will believe that kind of nonsense.
Save your nonsense for your dreams.

examples.japanese: ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧わけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。{寝言|ねごと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい{加減|かげん}→いい加減：09353_iikagen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しろ→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There's no way that's possible. Enough with the nonsense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧にしてほしい⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{寝言|ねごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ほど⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Wanting your salary doubled? That's beyond absurd.

notes:
FORMS:
{寝|ね} (sleep) + {言|ごと} (words)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寝言|ねごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ - to talk in one's sleep; to talk nonsense
- {寝言|ねごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧な - don't talk nonsense (dismissive)
- {寝言|ねごと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{言|い}え→言う：00515_iu⟧ - say your nonsense while sleeping (idiom meaning "stop talking nonsense")

RELATED 〜{言|ごと} WORDS:
- ⟦たわ{言|ごと}→たわ言：07394_tawagoto⟧ - nonsense, drivel
- ⟦{繰|く}り{言|ごと}→繰り言：07395_kurigoto⟧ - repetitive complaints
- ⟦{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}→独り言：07022_hitorigoto⟧ - talking to oneself

REGISTER:
Casual to neutral. The dismissive usage (sense 2) is informal.
